paper_title: Dark matter detection using nuclear magnetization in magnet with hyperfine interaction
notes: Theoretical proposal (July 2023) for DM detection via nuclear magnons in canted antiferromagnet MnCO3 with strong hyperfine interaction; sensitivity PROJECTIONS only (1 kg sample, 1 yr, T=0.1 K, SNR>=1). The paper projects limits on THREE couplings: axion-proton g_app (Fig. 7), axion-electron g_aee (Fig. 8, reaching ~1e-14 at ~1e-6 eV), and dark photon kinetic mixing eps (Fig. 9). Chose AxionProton as primary since paper explicitly states 55Mn nuclear spin is proton-dominated (sigma_p~0.1, sigma_n=0), overriding the AxionNeutron hint, and the headline result is g_app >~ 1e-11 at m_a ~ 1e-6 eV covering unexplored parameter space. Emitted data points are an approximate flat line over the nuclear-dominated mode band (500-600 MHz -> 2.07e-6 to 2.48e-6 eV) from text statements; full sensitivity curves are only in figures (not machine-readable here). Electron-dominated mode band (45-55 GHz, ~1.9-2.3e-4 eV) is stated to NOT beat astrophysical bounds for g_app. Confidence level not explicitly stated (SNR>=1 criterion); 0.95 is nominal.
